title: MERP: A Latent-Bottleneck Framework for Robust Multi-Modal Multi-Label Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.29430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal multi-label emotion recognition is important for affect-aware systems, but models trained with complete text, visual, and acoustic streams often degrade sharply when some streams are unavailable at deployment. We address this train-test gap by learning a compact representation that preserves emotion-specific evidence from any available subset of modalities. We propose the Multi-modal Emotion Recognition Perceiver (MERP), which maps the joint sequence into a fixed-size latent bank, thereby keeping repeated reasoning independent of raw input length; it extracts label-specific evidence before and after latent reasoning and aligns the two levels through reconstruction. translated_title: MERP：一种用于鲁棒多模态多标签情感识别的潜空间瓶颈框架
translated_abstract: 多模态多标签情感识别对情感感知系统非常重要，但在完整文本、视觉和声学流上训练的模型，在部署时某些模态流不可用的情况下往往会出现性能急剧下降。我们通过学习一种紧凑的表示来解决这种训练-测试差异，该表示能够从任何可用的模态子集中保留情感相关的证据。我们提出多模态情感识别感知器（MERP），它将联合序列映射到一个固定大小的潜变量库中，从而使反复推理与原始输入长度无关；它在潜空间推理之前和之后提取标签特定的证据，并通过重构对齐这两个层次。MERP进一步使用正负类别原型、训练期间带有频率整形扰动的噪声门控特征增强器，以及置信度感知的类别级融合，以增强类别可分性、降低对缺失输入的敏感性，并融合来自不同模态的互补证据。
tldr: 提出了MERP框架，通过潜变量瓶颈表示、正负类别原型、噪声门控特征增强和置信度感知融合，实现了模态缺失情况下依然鲁棒的多模态多标签情感识别。
en_tdlr: MERP is a latent-bottleneck framework that combines class prototypes, noise-gated feature enhancement, and confidence-aware fusion to achieve robust multimodal multi-label emotion recognition even when some modalities are missing.
